headline: Federal-Mogul Goetze notifies the exchange of capacity addition
hook: Routine capacity expansion at Federal-Mogul Goetze
summary: Federal-Mogul Goetze (India) Limited has officially informed the stock exchanges regarding a capacity addition. The announcement did not disclose financial details, capital expenditure figures, or the specific timeline for commercial production. Such routine filings keep shareholders informed about operational updates but typically lack immediate financial impact. Indian retail investors tracking the auto-components sector should await further details on production scale before factoring this into valuations.
why_it_matters: Operational update lacks immediate financial triggers for retail portfolios

headline: Jason Wesley Johnson resigns as Non-Executive Director of Federal-Mogul Goetze
summary: Federal-Mogul Goetze (India) Limited announced that Mr. Jason Wesley Johnson has resigned from his position as Non-Executive Director. The resignation is effective from the close of business hours on October 9, 2026. This is a routine board-level change for the listed auto component maker.
why_it_matters: Routine board exit with no direct impact on retail investors

headline: Federal-Mogul Goetze (India) appoints new Company Secretary and Compliance Officer
summary: Federal-Mogul Goetze (India) Limited has officially informed the stock exchanges about the appointment of a new Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The regulatory filing details the administrative leadership change within the company. Compliance officer transitions are standard corporate governance updates required under SEBI regulations. Indian retail investors generally see minimal direct stock impact from routine compliance officer changes unless accompanied by broader management shifts.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no direct impact on share price

headline: Federal-Mogul Goetze appoints Sachin Duggal as Additional Director
hook: New board seat at Federal-Mogul Goetze
summary: Federal-Mogul Goetze (India) Limited has announced the appointment of Sachin Duggal as an Additional Director in the capacity of a Non-Executive Director. The appointment is effective from October 09, 2026. This is a routine board-level change for the listed auto components manufacturer. For an Indian retail investor, board appointments of non-executive directors have a minimal direct impact on immediate share price movement.
why_it_matters: Routine board change with no direct impact on stock price.
